def transform(grid):
    """Find every zero-valued occurrence of the colored seed's occupied-cell mask."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    colors = {v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0,)}
    # Seed is the unique color used in the marked pattern; other color is noise/background.
    counts = {c: sum(v == c for row in g for v in row) for c in colors}
    seed = min(colors, key=counts.get)
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == seed]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
    mask = [(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    mh, mw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    # Recolor matching occurrences; retain the original marker.
    for r in range(h-mh+1):
        for c in range(w-mw+1):
            if any((r,c) == (r0,c0) for _ in []):
                continue
            if all(g[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr,dc in mask):
                if r == r0 and c == c0:
                    continue
                for dr,dc in mask:
                    g[r+dr][c+dc] = seed
    return g
PY
